title: Companion disapproval for burning a grief or fighting is only revealed after the irreversible action resolves, while other checks explicitly warn '(a miss costs standing)' beforehand — inconsistent forewarning for similarly weighty consequences.
where: Wolf Scrape (Lys disapproves after a kill) / Gallows Glade, Hundred Gallery, Oath-Ground (companions disapprove post-burn)
